positions.name: SiteCutoverSequencingStrategy
positions.frame: how should multi-site cutovers be sequenced when operational containment conflicts with local site friction?
positions.why: Weighs the trade-off between bounded, contained operational friction (running dual systems at a shared desk) versus unbounded risk (attempting parallel site cutovers with shared staffing).

positions.name: PostGoLiveSoakDurationBasis
positions.frame: how is the minimum soak duration between site cutovers determined and validated?
positions.why: Grounds the two-week soak policy in historical exception-queue stabilization data from the Dockside pilot, balancing empirical caution against pressure to shorten timelines.

positions.name: CutoverReportingReadIsolation
positions.frame: how are reporting workloads isolated from production systems during high-load cutover windows?
positions.why: Establishes a mandatory runbook rule isolating production instances by offloading all reporting queries to replicas during cutovers, trading minor query latency for outage prevention.

positions.name: ReferenceDataSourceOfRecordTransition
positions.frame: at what milestone in a multi-site rollout should reference data authority transfer from vendor to internal systems?
positions.why: Determines that vendor reference data remains the single system of record throughout the entire migration programme until the final site (Clyde) goes live, preventing configuration drift.
